title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship 2025
organization: Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation / University of Cambridge
eligibility: Citizens of any country outside the UK applying to pursue a full-time postgraduate degree at Cambridge.
salary: Fully Funded (Full tuition, £20,000+ annual stipend, flight costs)
qualification: Bachelor's degree with outstanding academic record and leadership potential.
description: Full-cost scholarships for outstanding applicants from countries outside the UK to pursue a full-time postgraduate degree in any subject available at the University of Cambridge.

title: Software Engineering Intern, Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD program in Computer Science or related technical field.
qualification: Experience in C++, Java, Python, or Go; strong foundation in algorithms and data structures.
description: Join Google for a 12-14 week paid summer internship working on real-world engineering problems across products like Search, Cloud, and Android.

title: Junior Frontend Developer (React)
eligibility: Open to candidates worldwide passionate about open source and web technologies.
qualification: Degree in Computer Science or equivalent hands-on experience in React, TypeScript, HTML/CSS.
description: Build responsive web interfaces for Ubuntu tools and Canonical cloud software as part of a globally distributed open-source team.

title: Associate Product Analyst
eligibility: Recent graduates or early-career professionals with 0-2 years of experience in product or data analysis.
qualification: Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Economics, or related quantitative field.
description: Work alongside product managers and engineers to analyze user behavior, define payment feature specs, and drive digital commerce products.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup 2025
eligibility: Students aged 16 or older enrolled in high school or university worldwide.
qualification: Students interested in software development, AI, and social entrepreneurship.
description: Global student tech competition inviting participants to create innovative AI solutions addressing social, environmental, or economic problems.

title: CS50's Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide with internet access; no prerequisites required.
qualification: Beginner-friendly; open to students of all educational backgrounds.
description: An entry-level computer science course teaching algorithmic thinking, problem-solving, and fundamentals of C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
